'''Galven coils''' were a type of technology used in energy-based weapons such as [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The coils served to focus the energy released into a coherent beam of focused plasma capable of causing damage to a target. Such coils were used specifically in the [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] [[medium laser cannon]] used by the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].
